---
title: "Activity Reports"
---

ÇAHSPAR’s activity reports provide a transparent account of the association’s research, training, projects and public engagement. They make it easier to follow and assess our activities and contributions.

## Areas Covered

- Research and analytical activities
- Training, seminars and workshops
- Joint projects and partnerships
- Public visibility and communications
- Stakeholder participation and event outcomes

The reports also provide measurable indicators of the association’s contribution to its central goals: quality of working life and social equality.
